name: repokeel
description: Persistent project state for AI coding agents

interface.shortDescription: Keep coding agents grounded in the real state of ongoing engineering work.
interface.longDescription: Persistent project state for safe continuation across coding-agent sessions, with task-source realignment, Git and worktree evidence, bounded recovery, and explicit next actions. Existing bootstrap, delivery, closeout, and hook entry points remain auxiliary and reuse project authorities rather than creating another plan or orchestration system.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project and preview its RepoKeel setup.
Resume this work unit and recommend the next safe action.
Refresh this task's workspace evidence before writing.
Verify the current candidate before merge or cleanup.
